name: Watcher in the Woods
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 6, shaman 6

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a bone carving knife and 2500 gp in incense)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target a Medium or larger tree
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw no; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You have given eyes to the woods so that they may defend you. To cast this spell you carve a seal into the target tree and then grind the knife into bone meal and sprinkle it around the tree.

At the end of the ritual the tree awakens as a treant and will guard an area of 1 square mile centered on its original square. The tree will otherwise treat you as friendly and follow your commands. It will not attack creatures you consider allies or creatures of the animal and plant types except in self defense or directed by you as a standard action.

While the treant is animate you may focus to use its senses. You spend a standard action to begin doing so and may share senses with the treant until you wish for the effect to end or the spell ends. You cannot give commands to the treant while using its senses but you may cast the spells message and read magic through its sight.
